project.title: Metagenomic analysis shows diverse, distinct bacterial communities in biofilters among different marine recirculating aquaculture systems
project.description: We characterized and compared the bacterial communities of nine nitrification biofilters in five commercial recirculating marine aquaculture operations by amplifying and sequencing the 16S rRNA gene using the Illumina-MiSeq DNA sequencing platform
